**1,061 commits from 412 contributors (120 new).** Thank you!

Abstract: Personal assistants accumulate months of conversations, but today's long-term memory stacks put derivation or selection between a question and its evidence. arXiv:2611.22033v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers.
